instruction: Pour the liquid from the bottle into the cup.

arguments.note: The bottle is in front of the left arm, with the cup farther back. I approach the bottle body horizontally so its neck stays clear for pouring.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 39 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The previous approach stopped early. I continue to the staging point ahead of the bottle.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 19 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The bottle has tipped onto its side during the approach. I lift clear before changing to a top-down recovery grasp.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 23 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The bottle lies diagonally with its neck to the right. I rotate above it to place the jaws across its body.

calls.tool_result: left arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The combined rotation was refused. I change only the pitch first while clear of the bottle.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 37 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: I continue pitching toward a downward grasp while remaining above the bottle.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 20 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I align the downward jaws across the bottle's diagonal body rather than along its neck.

calls.tool_result: left arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: I separate the remaining rotations to avoid the rejected combined pose.

calls.tool_result: left arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The high downward pose is unreachable. I move closer above the bottle at a lower clearance height before rotating further.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 9 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: At this lower position I retry aligning the jaws downward and across the bottle body.

calls.tool_result: left arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: I keep the current jaw heading and test a smaller downward rotation.

calls.tool_result: left arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: I approach the bottle body with the reachable angled grasp, stopping above its surface for a visual check.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 12 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The body is centered but diagonal between the jaws. I turn the jaws across it before descending further.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 15 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws now span the bottle body. I lower toward its sides, leaving the neck unobstructed.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws straddle the bottle near its lower body. I descend five millimetres and close to secure it.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The gripper has stopped against the bottle body. I make a short test lift to verify it is held.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The bottle did not lift; the jaws closed above its sides. I reopen and straighten the tool at this lower reachable height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 21 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The downward alignment is now achieved. I lower the open jaws around the bottle's body.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The last 1 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws are around the bottle sides. I lower another five millimetres and close for a deeper grasp.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws remain separated by the bottle. I test the deeper grasp with a short vertical lift.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The bottle lifted with the jaws. I carry it toward the cup with its free neck extending over the opening.

calls.tool_result: left arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The higher transfer pose was refused. I use a lower transfer while keeping the bottle above the tabletop.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 15 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Liquid is escaping while the bottle is sideways. I raise the neck immediately to stop the spill before realigning over the cup.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 33 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The neck has begun rising. I continue toward upright to retain any remaining liquid.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 35 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The bottle is nearly upright and the cup is now farther back. I raise and offset the bottle so its neck can tip toward the cup opening.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 10 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The cup opening is visible behind and to the right of the bottle. I advance the bottle so the neck's tipping arc ends over that opening.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: With the bottle clear of the rim, I begin a controlled tilt and will check the neck's position before pouring farther.

calls.tool_result: left arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The larger tilt was refused. I try a smaller tilt at the same clearance position.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 17 waypoints (0.7s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The cup sits to the side of the current neck trajectory. I draw the bottle back slightly and lower it to align the mouth over the rim during the final tilt.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 15 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The neck now approaches the cup from the left. I tip toward horizontal to direct remaining liquid into the opening.

calls.tool_result: left arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: I use a smaller tilt because the near-horizontal target was unreachable.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 15 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The mouth is just left of the cup. I lower and shift it slightly toward the opening before the final tilt.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The bottle mouth is aligned beside the cup opening. I tip the bottle to horizontal to pour.

calls.tool_result: left arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: I use a smaller tilt and slightly lower grasp height to keep the wrist within reach while keeping the neck above the cup.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 9 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.hindsight: The initial approach should have stayed above the bottle until its position was verified. After recovering the sideways bottle, I should have restored it upright before transporting it and used a clearer side view to align the mouth with the cup.
arguments.reason: The bottle tipped during the initial approach and liquid spilled onto the table. Recovery did not produce a successful pour into the cup.

calls.tool_result: Acknowledged give_up.
